dod_intent_evidence: DoD-funded SCARIE Phase II SBIR ($1.5M, 2022) exists and is genuine, but the company's 20-year pattern — 'more than 20 government programs,' DARPA/IARPA/NSF/NIST 'seedling' funding, a team dominated by PhD 'Research Scientist' titles, and testing partners that are themselves research orgs (MIT Lincoln Lab, RAND, JHU APL) rather than deployed units — shows a research house whose business model is winning government R&D awards, not fielding products.
what_they_do: Applied-cryptography research house (secure multiparty computation, zero-knowledge proofs, searchable encryption) performing on dozens of DARPA/IARPA/NSF/NIST/DoD grants over 20 years; no visible fielded product or named end customer.
